principle: Supplied cards are research inputs, never the boundary of the candidate universe.
researchExpectations: Detect the active eligible slate before reviewing candidate quality.
Search every eligible game and supported market family for plausible candidates.
Create an independent shortlist without copying the supplied card list.
Compare supplied-card candidates with the independent shortlist only after discovery.
Include independently discovered candidates even when no supplied source mentions them.
Do not promote a supplied candidate merely because several supplied cards repeat it.
Verify and cite the facts used to score each candidate.
Return no candidate when the research does not support one rather than forcing a pick.
